# webresources commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `create` | Create a new web resource from a local file |
| `get` | Get web resource content |
| `list` | List web resources in the environment |
| `publish` | Publish web resources (alias for ppds publish --type webresource) |
| `pull` | Pull web resources to a local folder with tracking metadata |
| `push` | Push locally-modified web resources back to Dataverse |
| `update` | Update an existing web resource's content from a local file |
| `url` | Get the Maker portal URL for a web resource |
